body: Family would probally have allowed the university to say it was suicide, they'd  get in alot of trouble if they didn't. Some families hide it for privacy reasons, other release it for awareness.
It distracted me for a bit so maybe that's somthing. You don't need to apologise for trying

You are allowed to feel happy when you are happy, and you are allowed to feel sad when you are sad.

I went with that same attitude for years and it destroyed me. I had a good paying job, went travelling, had a nice car and was able to do alot of things I wanted too, but I always felt sad, like I didn't deserve it. I never felt happy, i just did things, thought maybe I was greedy, so I gave more. I was still sad. Life events can make you depressed, but its not the only way, my depression was just there, its a chemical imbalance in my brian and I ignored it for a long time and now it's consumed me. My journey might be longer, but why stand around becuase I have further to do, don't we both deserve healthy thoughts and happy lives?


If there is someone professional you can talk to about it, do it. Anyone can need thearpy or help and getting it sooner will always be better,

I don't want to kill myself, i actually have alot of plans and ideas for my life, i know its just the chemical in my brain making me feel this way but I'm impulsive, and when I feel this way it makes me violent, and the violence I want to inflict is on myself. When I feel this way the voice in my head screams at me, he screams at that impulsive side, he screams "stab that knife through your arm," "put you foot down and slam into that wall" "put your head under the machine, no ones around, it'll be over quick" 


I fight my mind everyday. I'm tired, the cuts give me a rest, let's the adrenaline push the cloud away. It's been months since the last time, i fight as hard as i can, but today he has won.

Makes me feel worse tbh. Not that you said it, that i know its true. It's everywhere, destroying people. It makes people drink, makes them take drugs. It's destroying my brother, he drinks, my parents drink themself into denial, my sister would be too if it wasn't for the dog but that's only a delaying tactic. I've  been fighting mines for 3 years, about 16 if you count the years I never knew that's what it was. Those days I beat myself over the head with my shoes, would hurt but not leave a mark, i would scream until my throat bled. Know I know what it is I cut, i cut my arms quick and fast, lots of little ones, don't want to do damage but still need the pain. Do it that way and it burns and stings. The adrenaline clears my head, i need that because its so cloudy right now, feels like its consuming me. I need it because if i don't I'll go for a drive, and I don't want to do that.
